lane: ESSAY-005 LANE 2: H^1 via Q/Z fractional-part cocycle
verdict: REFUTED (rigorous obstruction). delta(y* mod Z) is neither well-defined nor gauge-invariant, and where defined is forced to 0 -- it can never be the nonzero detector the conjecture needed.
construction_tested: Cover U = maximal cliques of conormal power G^{vk}; nerve 1-simplex = clique pair sharing >=1 vertex; optimal LP-dual 0-cochain y* (clique weights); ybar = y* mod Z; candidate class delta(ybar) via connecting map of 0->Z->Q->Q/Z, delta: H^0(U;Q/Z)->H^1(U;Z).

obstruction_1_cocycle_prerequisite.statement: delta is defined only on 0-cocycles: need y*(K)==y*(K') mod Z on every overlapping clique pair.

C7_k2_canonical_dual.reason: a 1/4-valued edge-square meets a 0-valued clique; 1/4 not in Z

obstruction_1_cocycle_prerequisite.consequence: delta(y* mod Z) is UNDEFINED at C7 -- exactly the fractional/stuck case where C-A1 predicted a NONZERO class.

obstruction_2_gauge_noninvariance.statement: optimal dual face is positive-dimensional; different optima give different (even ill-defined) objects -> not a coboundary/gauge invariant -> not a cohomology class.

C5_k2.consequence: same optimal face: one optimum is a defined cocycle (delta=0), another is not even a cocycle. The class depends on which optimal dual is chosen.

obstruction_3_forced_zero.statement: nerve connected => H^0(U;Q/Z)=Q/Z (global mod-Z constants only). ybar is a cocycle iff y* is globally constant mod Z. delta of a global constant = [d(constant lift)] = [0] = 0 in H^1(U;Z).
obstruction_3_forced_zero.consequence: whenever delta(y* mod Z) IS defined it is identically 0; it can NEVER output the nonzero class C-A1 wanted for C7. The detector has no nonzero value available.

trivial_repair_also_dead: Taking the ordinary Cech coboundary d(ybar) in C^1(U;Q/Z) instead of the connecting map yields a class that is a coboundary by construction, hence 0 in H^1(U;Q/Z) for every graph -- detects nothing (0 at both C5 and C7).
out_of_sample_C9_k2: not computed: construction refuted at the prerequisite level, so there is no well-defined class to predict. Obstruction is structural, not size-dependent: any properly fractional dual (denominator>1) on a strict subset of cliques meets a 0-valued clique (non-cocycle), and packing-LP optimal dual faces are generically positive-dimensional (gauge-dependent).
relation_to_prior: Sharpens formalA Category-Error Guard #1 (altitude error) with the precise mechanism: y* lives in C^0(Q), its mod-Z reduction is a cochain not a cocycle, the connecting map is inapplicable in the fractional cases, and the dual is non-unique. Confirms S_k is degree-0-only; no natural H^1 of this cover refines the integrality gap.
